episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: On Academy Island, elite students fight for ranks in games. When transfer student Hiroto somehow defeats champion Sarasa to gain the title of Seven Stars, he realizes the games are built on lies. But what brought Hiroto to the island in the first place?
